name: specz
description: A lightweight engineering-state and design-review protocol for capable coding models, with optional checkpoints, governed evidence, and structured human review briefs.

interface.shortDescription: Lightweight state, evidence, and design review for capable coding models.
interface.longDescription: Specz lets capable coding models plan and execute natively. It externalizes only engineering state that must survive the current context, and optionally turns a formed design into a structured Chinese review brief with explicit facts, decisions, verification coverage, risks, and open questions. Direct execution remains the default; checkpoints, governed evidence, and review documents are enabled only when requested or valuable.
defaultPrompt: Use specz to decide whether this task needs durable engineering state before implementing it.
Use specz to resume the active checkpoint and execute the next ready task unit.
Use specz-brief to turn the current design into a structured Chinese review document.
